race.comment: SALINA SPECIAL (6) earns top billing after putting a plain resumption behind him with an authoritative Wodonga BM52 win, scoring by just over two lengths as favourite. The rise in grade is the obvious adjustment, but his lightly raced profile, third-up set-up and 2kg claim give him a strong platform. WAMBEEN (7) has built neatly this campaign, winning a Wodonga BM52 after a solid Tatura second, and his 1600m record keeps him right in the argument despite stepping up in grade. BELNERA (8) ran a close Wagga second last start with some traffic around the turn. Fitter and can keep improving. FERRARI MAN (4) won by 0.7 lengths last start at Orange and should race on the speed, in the mix.
